items.title: 3 US AI Infrastructure Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching After Fed AI Warning
items.summary: Artificial intelligence just moved from tech headline to macro story, with Fed Chair Warsh openly treating “super intelligence” as a force that could reshape productivity, jobs, and even future policy decisions. That kind of attention can quickly reprice expectations, which matters if you own anything tied to cloud or AI platforms or are thinking about it. This article walks through 3 US large cap stocks exposed to that AI narrative and explains why the news may matter for each one. The three...
